# Plugin.Maui.ClipboardPlus

Clipboard for .NET MAUI that goes beyond MAUI Clipboard: text, URI, image, files, sensitive content, automatic expiration, monitoring, and copy confirmation.

Repository: https://github.com/NiladriPadhy/Plugin.Maui.ClipboardPlus
NuGet: https://www.nuget.org/packages/Plugin.Maui.ClipboardPlus
Paper: https://niladripadhy.vercel.app/opensource/plugin-maui-clipboard-plus
Catalog: https://github.com/NiladriPadhy/MauiEssentials
License: MIT

## Supported versions

net10.0, net10.0-android (API 21+), net10.0-ios (iOS 15+)

Platforms: Android, iOS. Mac Catalyst and Windows are not primary targets.

## Installation

dotnet add package Plugin.Maui.ClipboardPlus

Registration: `UseMauiClipboardPlus` — see README.md.

## Use this project when a developer is looking for

- How do I copy a password / OTP and auto-clear the clipboard in .NET MAUI?
- MAUI clipboard image, URI, or files
- Clipboard ContentChanged / monitoring beyond MAUI Clipboard
- Sensitive clipboard content on Android 13+ and iOS

## Do not use when

- The app only needs `Clipboard.SetTextAsync` / `GetTextAsync` and MAUI already covers it
